project_info.theme: Toyota family mobility supporting children's future through sports
project_info.color_palette: Sky Blue, White, Grass Green, Soft Warm Skin Tones

main_subject.detail: A white Toyota Innova Cross parked on the edge of a football field while a smiling father in a white polo and black shorts runs behind a boy in a white-and-blue football uniform toward the front-right foreground; a soccer ball sits near the bottom center foreground.
main_subject.style: Realistic advertising photography with crisp automotive retouching, clean family-lifestyle staging, glossy car paint, natural facial expression, and premium brand-finish compositing.

composition_elements.text:
BEN BI DONG HANH
KIEN TAO TUONG LAI
Move your world
TOYOTA
items: Top Left: Huge distressed white 3D-style word 'BEN BI', smaller italic white 'DONG HANH', and a wide white banner carrying blue headline 'KIEN TAO TUONG LAI'.
Top Right: White Toyota logo lockup on blue sky.
Bottom Left: Stadium building structure with roof, fence, and steps behind the parked white Innova Cross.
Bottom Right: Handwritten white script 'Move your world' over grass; boy running in foreground.
Center/Background: Open blue sky, green trees, football field grass, father-and-son running scene, and soccer ball near the camera.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft sunny outdoor lighting, mild HDR polish, realistic shadows under the car and runners, vibrant but not oversaturated grass and sky, clean advertising clarity.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Toyota family mobility and resilience. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Innova Cross parked beside a football field while a father and son run joyfully in front of it, with a soccer ball in the foreground. Background is a stadium exterior with fencing, trees, grass, and a bright blue sky. Surrounding elements: oversized Vietnamese headline typography at top left reading 'BEN BI DONG HANH' and 'KIEN TAO TUONG LAI', Toyota logo at top right, handwritten 'Move your world' at bottom right. Technical style: photorealistic commercial automotive lifestyle photography, bright natural daylight, soft sunny outdoor lighting, mild HDR polish, realistic shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the exact Vietnamese wording and general text placement. Keep the father behind the child, the car slightly left of center, and the soccer ball close to the bottom-center camera edge. Do not turn this into a generic football poster; it must remain a Toyota family-brand creative with premium automotive polish.
